items.title: 12.5 Smog aur PAN banne mein NO aur NO2 ka kirdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5 with the Did You Know box on Lahore smog, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOx jandar ajsam par ba-shumar nuqsan-deh asrat ka zimmedar hai. Fiza mein us ke do asar photochemical smog (12.5.1) aur peroxyacyl nitrates ka banna (12.5.2) hain. Lahore ki smog volatile organic compounds (VOCs), NOx, zameeni satah ki ozone, particulate matter PM2.5, CO aur SO2 par mushtamil hai.

blocks.prompt: Lahore ki smog mein kya hai, aur us ke kaun se ajza NOx chemistry se aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Volatile organic compounds, nitrogen oxides, zameeni satah ki ozone, bareek zarraat (PM2.5), carbon monoxide aur sulfur dioxide. Ozone aur peroxyacyl nitrates dhoop mein NOx aur VOCs se bante hain, to woh seedhe ikhraj ke bajaye NOx chemistry ke products hain.

items: NOx jandaron ko nuqsan deta hai; yeh photochemical smog aur PAN banne ka sabab hai; Lahore smog = VOCs, NOx, O3, PM2.5, CO, SO2.
